notes: Full four-player table and private value-layer template, not one row plus a duplicate revealed pile.
Official Korean product sheet confirms structure/procedure but not exact starting-deal counts; no guessed fixed row slots/counts are supplied.
Other regional rules may keep a drawn tile aside until turn end; this asset explicitly preserves the current Korean insert-first convention.
No commercial numbers/font/logo copied. Blank value windows are original placeholders, while actual known values belong in JSON.

structureEvidence.location: official Korea Boardgames product detail and its first two directly viewed gameplay/component images
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 2–4인 제품, 실제 세운 흑백 타일행, 상대 공개 타일과 비공개 자기 코드행. 공식 상품 이미지/설명에는 숫자 타일 24개와 조커 2개, 작은 값부터 오른쪽으로 정렬, 동값이면 검정을 왼쪽에 둔다고 표시.

structureEvidence.access: exact pinned image directly viewed in four bounded panels
structureEvidence.location: component inventory and gameplay setup/draw/guess/reveal panels
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 24numbertiles0–11 in black/white plus2jokers;2–4players; physical upright hidden and laid-down revealed positions; ascending owner-left order,black-first ties; current Korean insert-on-draw sequence; all revealed player eliminated.

assetScope: All2–4player code rows, unordered hidden pool, optional excluded jokers, same-id private/public face layers, revealed posture and current-draw/guess checkpoint. Assets only.

tableModel.edition: Korea Boardgames current product PD2024002346M4NG, Gakken black/white upright-panel edition; official product gameplay diagrams are the structural authority

componentInventory.numberTileCopies: one white and one black of each value
componentInventory.jokerUse: enabled only if the actual selected rules use them; otherwise keep in unused area

coordinates.orderedRow: left-to-right from owner perspective. Seat/camera rotation must not reverse orderedTileIds.
coordinates.physicalTile: bodyColour, standing/revealed posture and face visibility are independent; relative 3D-looking surfaces are original diagram geometry, not photographed mesh
coordinates.rowOverflow: fit/scroll or expand scene to all actual tile instances, never truncate to six example shapes

sortConvention.equalNumbers: black before white from owner left
sortConvention.joker: preserve actual inserted index; never assign a numeric value or auto-sort the joker into a guessed position

tableModel.koreanEditionProcedure: The official Korean gameplay image says draw one tile and insert it in order before making a guess. Keep the drawnTileId even after insertion: wrong guess reveals that drawn tile; a correct guess can continue or stop. Do not replace this with an imported edition that holds the draw to one side until turn end.
tableModel.setupQuantity: Publisher product sheet says take the player-count-specific number but does not print the table of counts. No unverified per-player starting count is embedded. Actual existing rows, remaining pool and optional jokers are fully representable.
tableModel.tileIdentity: Public row/revealed subset and owner-only value overlay refer to the same stable physical tile id. Revealing one tile changes posture/visibility; it does not duplicate it into a separate identity pile.

secretsExcluded: unrevealed joker status if not publicly known

tableModel.hiddenInformation: Do not solve or expose unknown tile values from colour, sort order, other players or deductions. Zero is a real number; null means unknown and is not zero. Public drawn-tile colour/index need not expose the drawn value.

fieldBindings.rows.scene: public row physical positions/colours/reveal subset per player
fieldBindings.identity.scene: owner-only values joined by same physical tile id

tableModel.ruleAutomation: No deduction, automated sorting, timing penalties, guess verification, forced reveal or winner calculation.

diagramOnly: six row tiles and six pool tiles are examples, not initial distribution or capacity
value windows contain no invented numeric answers

auxiliaryAssets.purpose: Owner-only blank value-layer template keyed to the same row tile ids. Not a separate physical set and no numeric answers supplied.
